subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Should OpenClaw explicitly allow the managed-proxy bypass lease to cover the validated Playwright CDP WebSocket handshake for local managed Chrome?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but whether this direct loopback exception is an acceptable security boundary is a policy decision that cannot be inferred solely from tests or Playwright’s API contract.

options.title: Accept the exact validated bypass
options.body: Approve the patch’s scoped discovery and WebSocket lease because both endpoints remain subject to OpenClaw’s CDP SSRF validation.

options.title: Require a stricter boundary
options.body: Keep the PR open for a revised design if the intended policy must prohibit any Playwright-originated direct CDP handshake under managed proxy mode.

recommendation.title: Accept the exact validated bypass
recommendation.body: Approve the patch’s scoped discovery and WebSocket lease because both endpoints remain subject to OpenClaw’s CDP SSRF validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person connected to the predecessor loopback-CDP proxy behavior; current source-history ownership could not be established more precisely.
